title: [VSC-20] VS Code: AgentSeatTracker port with seat wiring that passes the shared seat corpus
description:
Epic epic-aabc654d (VS Code works + plugin reuse), sliced by task-a3e414a3 (VSC-0). Depends on VSC-19 (task-b3daad343a474830a6bd243991d5353d), which lands moe-jetbrains/src/test/resources/client-seat-tracker.json. This row must pass it UNCHANGED (held-out test).

Objective: a pure TypeScript port of JetBrains' AgentSeatTracker (moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/services/AgentSeatTracker.kt): the same constructor callbacks (load, save, deregister) and operations (launched, closed, resendGone, acked), plus a dependency-injected wiring function so VSC-21 only has to plug real objects in: `wireAgentSeats({ tracker, onDidCloseTerminal, workerIdOf(terminal), onConnected, onAcked })` that calls closed() for a closed terminal it can map to a worker id, resendGone() on every connected transition, acked() on each ack, and returns a Disposable that unsubscribes all three.

Deliverable: new moe-vscode/src/util/AgentSeatTracker.ts (no vscode import and no runtime import: every dependency arrives as a parameter) and new moe-vscode/tests/agent-seat-tracker.test.cjs that loads it under node:vm with a require map that throws on every name (tests/managed-vm.test.cjs loads the pure ManagedVm.ts this way), replays every corpus row, and tests wireAgentSeats with fake event sources.

Not in scope: AgentLauncher.ts, MoeDaemonClient.ts and extension.ts (VSC-21), any moe-jetbrains file, the corpus.

Verification (GLOBAL rail: never npm in the shared checkout): `git archive HEAD` of the whole repo into a fresh directory outside the checkout, overlay this task's files, then in <snapshot>/moe-vscode run `npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run lint && npm run compile && npm test` under `env -i HOME=$HOME PATH=$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.21.0/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin` (mem:gotcha-vscode-gate-from-wsl).
definitionOfDone: moe-vscode/tests/agent-seat-tracker.test.cjs replays every row of moe-jetbrains/src/test/resources/client-seat-tracker.json against AgentSeatTracker.ts and passes, with failing ids reported together.

With fake event sources, wireAgentSeats calls closed() once for a closed terminal that maps to a worker id and not at all for one that does not, calls resendGone() on each connected transition, calls acked() for each ack, and after dispose() reacts to none of them.
AgentSeatTracker.ts loads under a require map that throws on every module name and contains no vscode reference.
A scratch-copy mutant in which acked() does not save makes the test fail (mutant discarded afterwards); client-seat-tracker.json and every moe-jetbrains file are unchanged by this task's diff.
In a git-archive snapshot of HEAD plus this diff, `cd moe-vscode && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run lint && npm run compile && npm test` exits 0 with 0 failures.
